blurb: Guests can rent houseboats with no experience needed as training is provided. The marina offers a variety of boats including houseboats, pontoons, fishing boats, kayaks, and paddle boards. The location is near natural attractions like Blue Spring State Park and Hontoon Island.
extraNote: If you must cancel your reservation, notify us at least 30 days before your arrival date and your deposit will be refunded less a $300.00 cancellation fee. · Guests who cancel within 30 days of arrival receive no refund. · Pontoons, Fishing Boats, and Kayak Rentals Cancellations: If you must cancel your pontoon, fishing boat, or kayak reservation, call the marina at least 24 hours before your scheduled rental. · Guests who fail to cancel within this time frame or do not show up (no-call/no-show) will be charged the full rental amount. #See you on the river soon! · See you on the river soon! Look for another email coming your way with your rental forms and waivers. Fill them out ahead of time
